sent.title: Request sent to {name}
sent.intro: {name} has 48 hours to accept, decline or suggest another date. You don't pay anything yet.
sent.saveLink: Save this link to track your request
sent.linkInfo: It's your way back to the request's status and your conversation with {name}, no account needed. On this device you'll always find it under “Track a request”.
sent.linkInfoEmailed: It's your way back to the request's status and your conversation with {name}, no account needed. We've also sent it to {email}. On this device you'll always find it under “Track a request”.

noAccess.title: We can't open this request here.
noAccess.text: Requests open with the link you saved (or received by email), on the device you made the request on, or with the request number and your email.

steps.label: Request status
steps.requested: The chef has 48 hours to reply
steps.confirmed: As soon as the deposit arrives
steps.completed: After the service you can leave a review

intro.requested: {name} has 48 hours to accept, decline or suggest another date. You don't pay anything yet.
intro.acceptedDeposit: The deposit is still to be paid. As soon as the payment arrives, your booking is confirmed.
intro.acceptedDirect: Arrange the deposit directly with the chef. Once the chef marks it as received, your booking is confirmed.
intro.changeProposed: See the proposal below. If it works for you, accept it and the booking goes ahead.
intro.confirmed: Everything's arranged. You'll get a reminder the day before.
intro.completed: Tell us how it went. Your review helps other clients and the chef.
intro.declined: You can look for another chef who's free on the same date.
intro.expired: The chef didn't reply in time. Try another chef who's free on the same date.

details.title: Details
details.pickupPending: {area} · address sent once the request is accepted

footnote.deposit: The deposit is paid in the app; you arrange the rest directly with the chef.
footnote.direct: You arrange the service, prices and payment directly with the chef.

actions.cancelConfirm: Cancel this request? The chef will be notified.

review.thanksText: {name} will receive it and can reply publicly.
review.title: How did it go with {name}?
review.intro: Just pick the stars. You have 14 days after the service to leave a review.
review.commentPlaceholder: What did you order? What did you enjoy most? It helps whoever comes next.
review.showcase: I agree to a summary of this booking appearing on the chef's profile.

chat.label: Conversation
chat.emptyClient: Write to {name} here: allergies, timings, the address or anything else you need. Messages are kept with this booking.
chat.emptyChef: Write to the client here: allergies, timings, the address or anything else they need. Messages are kept with this booking.
chat.failed: Your last message wasn't sent. Please try again.

deposit.cardFailed: The card payment wasn't accepted. You can try again.
deposit.checkFailed: We can't confirm it right now. Please try again in a moment.
deposit.summaryNote: The deposit secures the date. You arrange the rest and pay it directly to {name} on the day of the service.
deposit.title: Deposit due
deposit.intro: {name} accepted your request. Pay the {amount} deposit to confirm your booking. You arrange the rest directly with {name}, on the day.
deposit.overdue: The deadline to pay the deposit has passed. You can still pay, but the chef may already have cancelled.
deposit.howToPay: How would you like to pay?
deposit.mbwayHint: You'll get a request in the app to approve within 5 minutes.
deposit.multibancoHint: We'll generate an entity and reference for you to pay via online banking or at a Multibanco cash machine.
deposit.mbwayWaiting: Open the MB WAY app on {phone} and approve the payment of {amount}.
deposit.cardWaiting: We've opened EuPago's secure page for you to pay {amount} by card.
deposit.multibancoSent: We've emailed you these details. Your booking is confirmed automatically as soon as the payment arrives. You can close this page.
deposit.processor: Payment is processed by EuPago. Ao Lume receives the deposit on the chef's behalf and passes it on after the service.

refund.success: Thank you. We'll make the transfer in the next few working days.
refund.doneText: We've received your details. The transfer of {amount} goes out in the next few working days.
refund.title: We're refunding you {amount}
refund.why: {reason}. As you paid by Multibanco reference, the bank doesn't allow refunds the same way: we need an account to transfer it to.
refund.warning: We only ever ask for your IBAN here, on this page. We never ask for it by email, phone or message. If anyone does so on behalf of Ao Lume, don't reply and let us know.

lookup.title: Find a request
lookup.hint: The number is on the confirmation screen and in the email, for example AL-1027-0482.

track.title: Track a request
track.intro: See the status of your request and talk to the chef. No account needed: use the link you saved, or search below.
track.account: Prefer to have everything in one place? <link>Create an account with the same email</link> and your requests will show up there automatically.
